topic: XII. Customisation and the skin API
statement: Neon's self-contained HTML mockup gallery renders all 17 scenes (M-01 to M-17) with live Strand v0.2 theme switching (cockpit-light, cockpit-dark, high-contrast), workbook/section filters, WCAG AA --amber-ink (#8A5A00 / #FFD04D), dual-stroke --focus-shadow (1px petrol + 3px amber), 45-degree teal-hatched --proposal-bg Preview Seam, and 6-tone Formula Reference Palette.
why: Demonstrates Strand v0.2 token refinements and contrast compliance visually across all 17 mockups.

statement: Rejects equating 'modern' with un-Excel card walls or proprietary formula dialects: Excel's calculation semantics, file format, and addressability are the bedrock, and everything above the grid is a task-specific instrument panel.

Modernity criterion 1 (Right representation for the cognitive job): five views—Notebook (narrative + live numbers), Inspector (causal graph + anomaly probes), Model Map (blocks, wires, z⁻¹ loops), App (sliders + scenarios), and Classic (keyboard-speed grid)—project the same live .xlsx workbook.

Modernity criterion 2 (Flight-deck instrumentation instead of modal dialogs): calm petrol chrome (#193F49) holds live readouts in Mast, Bridge and Strip while the model sits unobstructed on daylight paper (#FFFFFF/#EDF1F2).

Modernity criterion 3 (Preview before commit): structural or destructive edits (fill drags, wire connections, range rewrites, AI proposals) render first across a Preview Seam with recalculated deltas, and Esc is an exact lossless revert.

Modernity criterion 4 (Human and agent parity): every object has one canonical address (Monthly!D14, Orders[Amount], Inv.OnHand, block:Monthly/Revenue) shared identically by human navigation and AI agent diffs.
Quality priority rule: Honesty > Clarity > Familiarity (in Classic) / Density (calibrated per view).

Honesty never yields: never invent non-Excel numbers, never silently truncate 304k formulas, never disguise cached missing-link values as live, never hide errors behind formatting; state simplifications or decline with a concrete way forward.
Clarity governs presentation through Strand's single block geometry, weight, tabular numerals, and semantic signals rather than competing borders, rainbow palettes, or ribbon clutter.

Familiarity governs muscle memory, not chrome artwork: Classic honours Excel keyboard/mouse choreography without Microsoft icons, ribbons, or Office-blue chrome, while other views preserve shared shell shortcuts (Ctrl+K, Ctrl+G, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Alt+1..5).

Two densities only: Working density (22 px rows, 4–6 px gaps for Classic, Inspector, Model Map, Formula Explorer) and Reading density (68 ch measure, Source Serif 4 prose for Notebook and App); no third medium mode.
Rejected alternative: an Excel-clone light-grey ribbon, because it violates the no-Microsoft-artwork rule and wastes ~110 px of vertical height needed for split diagnostics and Formula Explorer.

Rejected alternative: hiding the grid behind a modern default on every opened .xlsx, because analysts opening 40-sheet legacy files expect immediate grid footing and distrust forced graph/doc landings.

Unified four-region shell shared across views: Mast (top 36 px petrol-800: badge, file/save, View Switcher Ctrl+Alt+1..5, Lens Alt+L, Explorer Ctrl+E, Agent Ctrl+I, Palette Ctrl+K, Print, Settings, non-modal trust pills), Bridge (34 px petrol-900: Unified Address Box Ctrl+G/Alt+D, Back/Forward Alt+←/→, plus view-specific controls), Stage (14 px rounded paper: SELECTED/EDITING, dual-stroke amber ring, 150 ms Continuity Halo, Preview Seam, Alt+Hover peek), and Strip (bottom 26 px petrol-800: sheet tabs with view micro-glyphs, Calc State, clickable Error Counter Pill, aggregates, Density, Semantic Zoom).

Strand v0.2 refinement 1 (amber contrast fix): raw #FFB301 on white fails WCAG AA (~1.84:1), so add --dna-amber-ink (#8A5A00 light ~5.7:1; #FFD04D dark ~12.4:1) for amber text/badges and render light-paper focus outlines as a dual-stroke ring (2 px #FFB301 outer + 1 px #193F49 inner keyline).
why: Passes WCAG AA contrast while keeping amber the sole saturated attention channel.

statement: Strand v0.2 refinement 2 (Preview Seam & Agent grammar without adding a hue): uncommitted AI proposals use a dashed teal-600 border over an 8% petrol-teal 45-degree hairline hatch (--dna-proposal-bg) with [⇄ Agent] badge, settling with a 150 ms green-500 fresh pulse on accept.

Strand v0.2 refinement 3 (editing-only Formula Reference Palette): adds 6 WCAG-checked accents (teal-ink, prov-const, green-ink, amber-ink, slate-ink #4A5D7A, plum-ink #6E4775—excluding error red #D02A23) paired with circled numbers ①②③④ matching Formula Bar superscripts, active only during editing or tracing.

topic: XII. Customisation and the skin API
statement: Strand v0.2 refinement 4 (Themes vs Skins): three Strand themes remain the canonical baseline while declarative Skins may override non-semantic tokens and arrange panels, checked by an automated Strand Contrast & Safety Gate blocking WCAG AA failures or repurposing of red/signal.

Strand v0.2 refinement 5 (Model Map preview harmonisation): ports directors, z⁻¹ delay chips, inline FSM diagrams, event queues and fan charts from names-in-motion/watershed into Strand's palette with dashed-double-stroke + ↻ badge for circular iteration blocks (zero extra hues).

Strand v0.2 refinement 6 (Instrument Overlay Layer in Classic): renders author Excel formatting faithfully on paper while placing DNA Calc structural signals (provenance micro-ticks, volatile corners, error triangles, selection halo) on a non-destructive overlay toggled via Ctrl+Shift+P.

Principle 1 (Excel Truth Over Visual Tidiness): expose exact Excel oddities (blank-to-0 coercion, OFFSET volatility, 1900 leap-year dates, range truncation) and explain them plainly rather than smoothing over them silently.

Principle 2 (Infer First, Declare Never Unless Correcting): every view delivers an honest first view on any plain .xlsx immediately without upfront schemas, persisting user/agent corrections quietly in customXml.

Principle 3 (Same Address, Continuous Place): switching views, opening Formula Explorer, or stepping agent diffs preserves anchor focus centered with a 150 ms Continuity Halo; Esc unwinds strictly one layer (Editing → Selected → Drawer Closed).

Principle 4 (Never Trap, Never Block, Never Hang): no modal security walls on open, no frozen scrollbars during 300k-formula indexing, and no dead-end App screens lacking a path back to the model (unless Excel sheet protection is set).

First paint of Inherited.xlsx (M-01): paints cached active sheet values in 180 ms (<220 ms) with zero blocking popups, docks a single non-modal Trust & Triage Banner (40 sheets / 6 hidden, 304k formulas, 47 errors / 4 roots, 3 missing links, 1 blocked macro modRollForward, 9 volatile OFFSET names), streams background dependency indexing in the Strip, marks unresolved external links with signal-orange ▸ ticks and errors with red left hairlines + ⊗ icons, exposes [+6 hidden ▾] without unhiding, and announces summary to screen readers.

Inspector on Inherited.xlsx (Ctrl+Alt+2, <60 ms, M-02) preserves Exec_Summary!D9 focus with 150 ms Continuity Halo, renders 40 sheets as a 4-tier Workbook Atlas (L0 Atlas) with dashed [hidden]/[veryHidden] tags, collapses 47 errors into 4 root causes with read-only fuzzy key hints ('NP15_Peak' vs 'NP15_PK'), and lists 9 volatile OFFSET names (142k downstream cells) with a non-destructive INDEX/Table tip.

Honest Model Map refusal on Dispatch_Hourly (M-03, 45 ms): declines rendering 182,400 cell boxes and displays a Scale Notice Banner confirming 100% coverage across 12 exact R1C1 formula-pattern runs (0 cells omitted), each with range span, shared formula, aggregates over all 8,760 rows, surfaced interior #DIV/0! jumps back to Classic, and Ctrl+Shift+C Markdown health summary export.

First visit to Notebook (Ctrl+Alt+3) presents a First-Run Scaffold Card choosing between 'Draft from Workbook Structure' (70 ms, Reading density 68 ch Source Serif 4, linked live without duplicating formulas) and 'Start Blank Notebook'.

Budget Notebook write-up (M-04): prose supports '=' / Ctrl+Shift+R inline Live Value Chips («$2,889,851») updating in <12 ms with 140 ms green pulse when toggling the inline Scenario Control (Inputs!C2); pasting Classic ranges creates a Linked Live Data Frame with a 5 s Paste Options chip (Ctrl); inline /calc formula blocks allocate a real backed Excel cell and defined name (Summary!B19 Cash_Runway_Gain) with no floating non-Excel math; Alt+P toggles Vertical ↔ Pipeline.

Notebook cross-view undo, export and accessibility: Ctrl+Z in Classic reverts edits made in Notebook with a Strip toast naming origin, Ctrl+S persists prose/layout in customXml, Ctrl+C exports resolved rich HTML + Markdown + SVG charts to email/Word, 200% zoom reflows prose cleanly, and live chips expose descriptive ARIA labels.

Sales discrepancy audit in Inspector (M-05, <50 ms): Formula Lens (Alt+L) structures SUMIFS as readable LET with live argument chips and row-count flags; Structural Anomaly Probe catches hardcoded Orders!$K$2:$K$20000 stopping 5,001 rows short of 25,000-row Table Orders, computes the exact excluded EMEA/Q3 slice (493 rows = $118,420.00 matching Pivot variance D14), maps downstream corruption (Rebate Tier F8 and Rebate G8), and offers a speculative Preview Fix to structured table refs.

Inspecting excluded rows jumps to Classic with a non-destructive diagnostic highlight (leaving Excel AutoFilter untouched); applying the structured-ref fix detects and offers to fix 3 matching sibling cells (Report!D6:D9) as one atomic Undo step (18 ms recalc), copies Markdown audit trace, and supports full keyboard graph traversal and aria-live announcements.

Model Map empty state offers starter actions (I Input Box, B Calc/State Box, G Group Frame, S Form Control Slider) noting every box writes standard Excel defined names on a visible sheet; port-to-port wiring (mouse drag or W key) rewrites real backing formulas through the AST Formula-Name Interpreter, and pasting vectors onto a box previews dynamic array spills.

Circular feedback Preview Seam on Model Map (M-06): self-wiring Inv.OnHand while Iterative Calculation is OFF pauses with an inline popover offering [Enable Iteration: 1 pass/tick (Ticks Director)], [Custom Iteration Settings…], or [Esc: Cancel Wire]; enabling updates standard Excel Iterative/MaxIterations/MaxChange properties, renders a dashed z⁻¹ delay loop and Ticks Director bar (▶ Run, Step F9, Reset), and S adds a genuine OOXML Form Control slider mirrored in the Parameter Rail.

Running ticks animates a 140 ms amber topological recalc ripple (instant highlights under reduced motion); switching to Classic (Ctrl+Alt+1, M-07) centers Inv.OnHand (StockModel!B18) with Continuity Halo, standard Excel formula, OOXML Form Control slider over D8:F8, teal spill border on B10:D10, and ↻ Iter overlay pill, with atomic cross-view Ctrl+Z undo and full keyboard graph navigation.

Loan App View (M-08, <140 ms open via preferredView='app'): calm Mast with explicit [View: App ▾] escape hatch; left validated inputs bound 1:1 to Loan!C3:C7 refusing out-of-range edits inline with Excel's Data Validation message (no modal popup); top tabular KPI cards; live Excel chart overlaying dashed Base vs active scenario curves (<12 ms slider recalc); side-by-side Scenario Comparison Table (backed by Excel Scenario Manager / customXml presets); and 360-row schedule grouped by Year (30 expandable rows).

App Print Preview (Ctrl+P) formats a 2-page Scenario Decision Brief (Page 1: inputs, comparison table, vector chart; Page 2: 30 annual rows with explicit disclosure and opt-in checkbox for all 360 monthly rows +6 pages), supports [Copy Summary] and Ctrl+Z, and provides logical keyboard tab order with aria-live KPI announcements.

Standalone DNA Calc - Formula Explorer (M-09): zero-workbook build with dot-long [.==] badge, Local Test Inputs (scalars/arrays/errors), searchable 512-function library, four tabs (Eval Tree, Number Format, Cond. Format, Add-in & Types), non-blocking signal-orange Dev Sandbox consent bar for unsigned .xll/.js add-ins, live per-argument coercion types and add-in error diagnostics (3 ms), and Ctrl+Shift+C formula copy.

Embedded Formula Explorer drawer (Ctrl+E, 38% right dock with pop-out [⤢], M-10) shares the identical UI pre-bound to the active cell's live precedents, renders speculative cell and downstream dependent deltas across the Preview Seam before commit (Ctrl+Enter), marks committed add-in cells with ▸ signal provenance, and exposes WAI-ARIA tree semantics for Eval Tree.

AI Agent Staged Proposal Batch (Ctrl+I, M-11): drafts read-only without blocking user; groups edits into named semantic hunks rendered across Strand's dashed-teal/hatched Preview Seam visible live in both Classic and Notebook prose chips; auto-quarantines hunks introducing errors or touching protected cells; commits per hunk (Alt+A) as atomic named Undo steps ([Agent ✓]) so Ctrl+Z surgically reverts Hunk 2 while keeping Hunk 1; records transparent exportable Session Audit Log.

All views share one conceptual model split cleanly along a single seam: Excel Workbook Model (standard OOXML calculation truth) vs Presentation Layer (layout, prose, annotations, inference overrides, skins in Excel-preserved customXml).

Unified Address Grammar covers seven entity kinds: Cell (Sheet!A1), Range (Sheet!A1:D12), Block (block:Sheet/BlockId), Name (Inv.OnHand), Table (Orders[Amount]), Object (obj:Sheet/ObjectName), and View Item (view:ViewId/ItemId, customXml only); View Items always carry a dotted focus frame and [View] tag so they are never mistaken for cells.

Selection Anchor + Navigation History Stack (Alt+←/Alt+→) translate focus across all five views without resetting to A1 (cell → Trace/Actor/Backing Cell/Chip binding; pure View Item → last workbook anchor on sheet with Strip notice), centering the target with a 150 ms amber Continuity Halo.

Non-grid edit mapping table: every non-grid gesture maps deterministically to plain Excel mutations (AST wire rewrite, slider cell write, assumption write, backed /calc cell+name allocation, Inspector structured-ref fix) or presentation-only customXml updates (prose, card order, box coordinates); Formula-Name Presenter/Interpreter operates strictly on parsed AST.

One chronological dual-tagged ([Model] / [View]) Undo/Redo stack per workbook spans all views; Ctrl+Z undoes the latest action without view whiplash (showing a Strip toast with [Jump]), Ctrl+Shift+Z peeks/filters history, and both model and customXml deltas journal continuously for non-modal crash recovery.

Visible state taxonomy: Errors distinguish Root Origin (filled ⊗) vs Propagated (hollow ⊘) in red-ink; Strip reports exact calc state (✓ Clean, ⚠ Dirty Manual [F9], ◐ Calculating % Esc-abortable, ↻ Iterative Converged vs Max-Reached Unconverged); RTD/external/async/volatile cells show signal-orange ▸ ticks with freshness hover and UI-side RTD throttle.

Agent safety contract: same Unified Address Grammar with zero backdoors; speculative Staged Proposal Batch over Preview Seam; semantic hunks with automated Safety Gate blocking blind batch-accept on new errors, protected cells, or iteration toggles; per-hunk commit as named Undo checkpoints + exportable Audit Log.

Classic is the default view for plain .xlsx files with full Appendix A Excel keyboard/mouse conformance, Ctrl+Shift+P Provenance Overlay, Ctrl+Alt+1 entry, and best fit for rapid modeling/editing across all cast workbooks.

Classic full-screen reference (M-12): single-row collapsible Strand Action Band (32 px default, 68 px expanded, full Alt Key Tips, zero Microsoft artwork), mid-edit numbered 6-tone Formula Reference Palette (①②③) matching Formula Bar superscripts, inline signature + live preview tooltip before Enter, and Strip reporting EDITING (Point) vs EDITING (Edit).

Inspector (Ctrl+Alt+2 or Strip Error Pill) is a Phyphox-inspired diagnostic bench: ←/→ walk precedents/dependents, ↑/↓ cycle siblings, Enter opens Explorer, Space collapses branch, Ctrl+Alt+1 jumps to Classic, Ctrl+Shift+C copies Markdown/CSV trace.

Inspector full-screen reference (M-13): combines Workbook Diagnostic Summary (errors, structural anomalies, volatile/external counts), interactive Causal Graph with live node values, Topological Calculation Order waves with millisecond hotspots, Live Data & Performance Probe (Ctrl+Alt+F9 re-profile), and actionable Probe Detail with Preview Seam fixes.

Notebook (Ctrl+Alt+3) provides Pluto-style live reactive documents: '/' opens slash-command block inserter, '=' inserts live value chips, Enter/Esc edit blocks, Alt+↑/↓ or Alt+←/→ reorder, Alt+P toggles Vertical ↔ Pipeline, Ctrl+V smart-pastes Classic ranges as Linked Data Frames; declines auto-dumping Inherited's 40-sheet sprawl.

Notebook Horizontal Pipeline reference (M-14): Alt+P arranges Inputs → Monthly Engine → Executive Rollup left-to-right linked by live teal dependency rails where hovering an input highlights downstream rows across stages.

Model Map reactions to names-in-motion & watershed: adopts hierarchical drillable composites with breadcrumbs, Excel-mapped Directors (Recalc/Iteration/Ticks/Sweep/Events), z⁻¹ delay chips, inline IFS/SWITCH state diagrams, Parameter Rail + Plotter, topological ripple, and Presented/Excel AST toggle; changes palettes to Strand (double-dashed teal + ↻ for iteration), replaces decorative turbine/wave motion with data-bearing sparklines/gauges, and adds optional Sheet Pages and L2 Formula-Run folding.

Model Map full-screen reference (M-15): shows double-line drillable composites ([⤵]), 140 ms amber recalc ripple along wires, collapsible view-state Plotter, synchronized Parameter Rail, and Inspector Mini-Card showing Presented vs Excel formulas; supports W-key wiring, Space F9 tick, L0→L3 Semantic Zoom, and Sheet Pages toggle.

App full-screen reference (M-16): distraction-free consumer UI with [View: App ▾] escape hatch, validated controls bound 1:1 to Excel cells, Alt+Hover formula peek on read-only KPIs, live Excel chart, year-grouped 360-row schedule, auto-generate or agent-build offer on unconfigured files, and honest decline on Inherited.

Formula Explorer dual-form reference (M-17): identical 4-tab workbench (Alt+1..4: Eval Tree, Number Format Lab across 4-section codes & locales, Conditional Formatting Simulator with non-mutating override test value, Add-in & Types) shared verbatim between Standalone zero-workbook build (Local Inputs sandbox) and Embedded drawer (Ctrl+E, live workbook pre-binding + Preview Seam).

Formula Lens (Alt+L across every view) substitutes defined names/Table headers, structures nested expressions into indented LET bindings with inline evaluated chips, and strips group prefixes; always displays '[Readable view · Hover/Alt for raw Excel]' and never alters stored formulas unless the user explicitly invokes 'Refactor cell to real LET in workbook'.

Non-blocking Pattern Inference Pass combines six verifiable Excel signals—grid geometry/OOXML objects, R1C1 formula signatures, cell provenance, dependency graph topology, number-format axes, and defined names/Data Validation—without brittle regex over labels.

Three calibrated confidence tiers: High (≥0.85, OOXML objects or unambiguous R1C1 structure, auto-applied), Medium (0.50–0.84, dashed 'Inferred · [Confirm / Change]' badge), and Low (<0.50, kept strictly as raw grid/cells—never fabricated into false abstraction).
Two-click human or agent block classification popover (Reclassify, Adjust Range, Merge/Split, Dismiss Inference) persists overrides in customXml so Excel preserves them and DNA Calc never asks twice.

Neon organises 18 recurring patterns into 5 families (Data & Reference, Parameters & Controls, Calculation Engines, State/Feedback/Stochastic, Governance/Automation/Presentation), adding three critical real-world patterns: #16 Reconciliations & check blocks, #17 Dynamic array / SPILL pipelines & LAMBDA libraries, and #18 External-link consolidation & staging hubs.
Inherited.xlsx (40 sheets, 6 hidden, 304,218 formulas, Dispatch_Hourly A1:CZ8760, 3 missing links, 1 VBA module, 9 OFFSET names, 47 errors) is the Show/Simplify/Decline stress benchmark.

Classic scaling policy — Shows all: Always renders the full virtualized grid (up to Excel's 1,048,576 × 16,384 bounds) on demand. Simplifies: When zoomed out `< 55%` (Semantic Zoom), swaps tiny cell text for **L1/L2 Block Headers** (`Dispatch_Hourly · 8,760 rows · ⊗5`); zooming back in restores every cell. Declines: Never declines—Classic is always the universal bedrock.

Inspector scaling policy — Shows all: Shows all 40 sheets (including hidden/very-hidden), all 4 error root causes, all 3 missing links, all 9 `OFFSET` names, and full trace of any selected cell. Simplifies: Collapses 47 errors to 4 root causes (expandable to all 47); collapses `Dispatch_Hourly`'s 182,400 cells into **12 R1C1 formula runs** inside the Workbook Atlas (`L0`) and Calc Order waves. Declines: Never declines; if a single cell has `> 500` direct precedents (e.g., `SUM` over 8,760 rows), shows the range as **one bounded range node** (`K2:K8761 · 8,760 cells`) with expand-on-demand instead of 8,760 arrows.

Model Map scaling policy — Shows all: Shows all nodes/wires when active scope has `≤ 120` actors/blocks (e.g., `Stock`, `Budget`, `Sales!Report`). Simplifies: For `121–2,000` cells or large uniform sheets (`Dispatch_Hourly`), automatically folds contiguous identical R1C1 formulas into **Formula-Pattern Runs** (12 runs = 100% of 182,400 formulas) with a persistent top Scale Notice (`M-03`), min/max/sum across all rows, and row-sample badge. Declines: **Declines cell-level graph** for `> 120` non-foldable bespoke cells on a single canvas or raw 25k-row database tables (`Orders`), displaying: *"Too dense for cell-level wiring (182,400 formulas). Showing 12 exact formula runs (100% covered) — or [Open in Inspector] / [Jump to Classic]."*

Notebook scaling policy — Shows all: Shows all curated prose, inputs, charts, and summary tables (`≤ 200` rows rendered directly). Simplifies: Large linked ranges or tables (`Orders` 25,000 rows) display as **Sampled Data Frames** showing the first 200 rows + full-table aggregates (`Sum/Avg/Count over all 25,000 rows`) with an unmistakable footer notice (`Showing 200 of 25,000 rows · Aggregates exact over all rows · [Inspect Full Table]`). Declines: **Declines auto-scaffolding** all 40 sheets of `Inherited` at once; presents a sheet picker pre-selecting `Exec_Summary` (*"40 sheets detected — pick which sheets to include in this Notebook"*).

App scaling policy — Shows all: Works whenever a clean Input/Output contract exists (explicit skin or high-confidence inference). Simplifies: Groups schedules `> 50` rows automatically by Year/Category (`Loan`'s 360 months → 30 expandable annual rows) with explicit count disclosure. Declines: **Declines auto-generation** on `Inherited`: *"This workbook has 40 sheets, 47 unresolved errors, and no clear input/output block. Triage in Inspector [Ctrl+Alt+2] or build an explicit App skin first."*

Formula Explorer scaling policy — Shows all: Always evaluates and displays the complete AST of any single formula. Simplifies: Array arguments `> 50` elements render as scrollable virtualized previews with explicit dimensions (`8,760 × 1 array · showing 1..20 · [Inspect All]`). Declines: Never declines a valid Excel formula.

Five honest simplification techniques: (1) named blocks with exact A1 bounds, (2) R1C1 formula-run folding always surfacing interior exceptions/errors, (3) L0→L3 Semantic Zoom keeping text ≥11 px, (4) local expand-on-demand, and (5) sampled previews stating exact row counts while computing aggregates over 100% of rows.

Performance budget (**File open → Interactive Cached First Paint** (`Inherited`, 304k formulas)): Desktop `≤ 250 ms`, Browser `≤ 450 ms`. Ceiling/fallback: Cached values paint immediately; dependency indexing streams off main thread with Strip progress.

Performance budget (**Keystroke echo** (typing in cell / Formula Bar / Notebook)): Desktop `≤ 12 ms` (1 frame @ 60–120 Hz), Browser `≤ 16 ms`. Ceiling/fallback: Input buffer never waits on recalculation or inference.

Performance budget (**Grid arrow navigation / smooth scroll** (60 fps)): Desktop `≤ 8 ms / frame`, Browser `≤ 16 ms / frame`. Ceiling/fallback: Strict viewport virtualization; zero DOM nodes for off-screen cells.

Performance budget (**View switch** (`Ctrl+Alt+1..5`, preserving anchor)): Desktop `≤ 60 ms`, Browser `≤ 100 ms`. Ceiling/fallback: Target view paints skeleton/cached layout within 1 frame if heavy layout runs async.

Performance budget (**Interactive edit → Recalc feedback** (`Budget`/`Loan`/`Stock` < 5k cells)): Desktop `≤ 16 ms`, Browser `≤ 30 ms`. Ceiling/fallback: Instantaneous; no spinner ever flashes for `< 150 ms` work.

Performance budget (**Heavy recalc progress indicator** (`Inherited` 304k formulas, volatile `OFFSET`)): Desktop Progress pill appears at `150 ms`; UI remains scrollable/cancelable (`Esc`), Browser Same (`150 ms` threshold). Ceiling/fallback: Never freezes the main thread; stale cells subtly dim with `◐ Calculating…` in Strip.

Three never-acceptable failure modes: never hang UI thread (>150 ms work runs off-thread with Strip progress and Esc abort), never silently drop content (always show exact coverage counts), and never misstate the model (mark cached missing links ▸, manual dirty cells, unconverged iterations, and run exceptions).

topic: XII. Customisation and the skin API

topic: XII. Customisation and the skin API
statement: Five declarative skin sections: (1) Theme token overrides checked by Strand Contrast & Safety Gate, (2) Layout & per-workbook/sheet view preferences and panels, (3) Keymap chords, (4) Macro-free UI Commands invoking built-in formatting/navigation primitives, and (5) Declarative widget cards bound to Excel addresses.

topic: XII. Customisation and the skin API
statement: Custom code is permitted only for genuinely new visualization/widget components delivered via an explicitly installed, signed extension/add-in—never for theming/layout/keymaps/Apps and never able to alter calculation.

topic: XII. Customisation and the skin API
statement: Skin workflow: authored via visual Skin Studio (Ctrl+K → Customize Skin) or AI Agent (Ctrl+I), previewed live through Preview Seam behind Strand Contrast & Safety Gate ([Keep Skin] [Save into Workbook] [Revert Esc]) reporting any auto-adjusted contrast token, and shared either embedded in customXml or exported as .dnaskin.

topic: XII. Customisation and the skin API
statement: Inviolable core no skin may alter: Excel calculation parity, semantic safety signals (#D02A23 error red, signal external/volatile, cached vs live, model vs view), WCAG AA accessibility floor and reduced-motion respect, Undo/Esc/Classic escape hatch (plus 1-click theme reset), and macro/add-in security boundaries.

topic: XII. Customisation and the skin API
statement: Worked skin Example 1 ('terminal-classic-v1'): YAML personal skin extending strand:cockpit-dark sets 19 px rows, #223840 gridlines (3.1:1 border check), Recursive Mono 650 totals, and binds Alt+Shift+B to a macro-free accounting-total-border command.

topic: XII. Customisation and the skin API
statement: Worked skin Example 2 (Loan App YAML): 0-code customXml/dnacalc-views.xml declaration binds preferredView='app', scenario presets on Loan!C3:C7, slider/segmented/date inputs, KPIs with deltaPolarity, baseline-overlaid excel-chart, year-grouped table, and 2-page decision-brief print config producing M-08/M-16.
Every view prints cleanly via Ctrl+P through a shared live Print Preview overlay (PDF or physical print) without forcing users back into Classic.

Classic printing: Exact Excel Print Area, manual/automatic page breaks, repeating header rows/columns, scaling (`Fit to 1 Page Wide`), headers/footers, and author formatting. Honesty/parity: Strict visual parity with Excel's printed page; Provenance Overlay pips default OFF on print (optional checkbox `[ ] Include diagnostic overlay`).

Inspector printing: Structured **Audit Report PDF**: Workbook Health Summary, Root-Cause Error Table (with cell coordinates & formulas), Structural Anomalies, Missing External Links, Volatile `OFFSET` Inventory, and Active Trace Diagram. Honesty/parity: Includes file hash, timestamp, calculation state (`Clean` vs `Cached/Dirty`), and exact counts so an audit PDF is defensible evidence.

Notebook printing: Typeset publication PDF using Source Serif 4 prose, live resolved values, clean vector charts, and gracefully paginated Data Frames (repeating headers across page breaks). Honesty/parity: Sampled Data Frames print a visible footer disclosure (`First 200 of 25,000 rows printed; aggregates exact over all 25,000`) or offer `[ ] Expand full table`.

Model Map printing: Vector **Engineering Drawing Sheet** with Strand title block (workbook, active scope, director settings, tick/state stamp, legend)—single-page fit or tiled multi-page poster, plus optional one-page-per-composite appendix. Honesty/parity: Declined/folded sheets print their exact `L2 Formula Runs` summary with the coverage disclosure stamp (`12/12 runs · 182,400 formulas`).

App printing: Executive **Decision Brief** (typically 1–2 pages): active scenario assumptions, comparison table, KPI strip, live vector chart, and grouped summary schedule (e.g., `Loan`'s 30 annual rows, with checkbox to append all 360 monthly rows). Honesty/parity: Discloses active scenario parameters and print timestamp; never drops schedule rows silently.

Formula Explorer printing: Single-page **Formula Verification Card**: formula text, inputs, evaluated AST tree, format preview, and add-in version. Honesty/parity: Ideal for code review or add-in bug reports.

Macro quarantine and view API: VBA/add-ins open blocked until trusted; standard Excel OM (Range.Value, Activate, Select, Calculate) works normally while an optional Excel-safe DNA Calc View API allows SwitchView, SelectAddress, ShowPanel, SetFormulaLens, SetScenario, and ShowNoticeBanner, strictly forbidding spoofing security banners, violating contrast/safety tokens, bypassing Agent Preview Seam, hiding the View Switcher, or altering non-Excel calc semantics.
Each storyboard runs as a 15-minute moderated usability test on desktop and browser including keyboard-only and screen-reader variants.
